name: Ouka Koisou
source:
In a cold village girl with a power to heal people serves as a shrine maiden. A series of murders occurs destroying peaceful village life. What is the connection between the girl and the murders? Oppose fate and find out the truth.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在一个寒冷的村庄里，一名拥有治愈他人力量的女孩担任巫女。一连串谋杀案发生，摧毁了村庄平静的生活。女孩与这些谋杀案有什么联系？反抗命运，查明真相。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
